scenario.name: Pirate Weather Daily Report
scenario.description: Fetches today's forecast from Pirate Weather once daily and formats a structured report with high/low temps, precipitation chance, moon phase, and local sunrise/sunset. Requires three credentials: pirate_weather_api_key, home_latitude, home_longitude.

agents.name: Fetch Pirate Weather
agents.description: Calls api.pirateweather.net once daily. Set credentials pirate_weather_api_key, home_latitude, home_longitude before enabling. Change 'units' to 'si' for Celsius/km.

agents.name: Format Weather Report
agents.description: Extracts forecast fields from the Pirate Weather API response. Outputs: temp_high, temp_low (°F), precip_chance (0-100), moon_phase (English), sunrise_local, sunset_local (12-hour local time), timezone, summary.

templates.moon_phase: {%- set p = response_json.daily.data[0].moonPhase -%}{%- if p < 0.03 or p > 0.97 -%}New Moon{%- elif p < 0.22 -%}Waxing Crescent{%- elif p < 0.28 -%}First Quarter{%- elif p < 0.47 -%}Waxing Gibbous{%- elif p < 0.53 -%}Full Moon{%- elif p < 0.72 -%}Waning Gibbous{%- elif p < 0.78 -%}Last Quarter{%- else -%}Waning Crescent{%- endif -%}
templates.sunrise_local: {%- set os = (response_json.offset * 3600) | int -%}{%- set ts = response_json.daily.data[0].sunriseTime + os -%}{%- set h = ((ts % 86400) // 3600) | int -%}{%- set m = ((ts % 3600) // 60) | int -%}{%- if h == 0 -%}12:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} AM{%- elif h < 12 -%}{{ h }}:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} AM{%- elif h == 12 -%}12:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} PM{%- else -%}{{ h - 12 }}:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} PM{%- endif -%}
templates.sunset_local: {%- set os = (response_json.offset * 3600) | int -%}{%- set ts = response_json.daily.data[0].sunsetTime + os -%}{%- set h = ((ts % 86400) // 3600) | int -%}{%- set m = ((ts % 3600) // 60) | int -%}{%- if h == 0 -%}12:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} AM{%- elif h < 12 -%}{{ h }}:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} AM{%- elif h == 12 -%}12:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} PM{%- else -%}{{ h - 12 }}:{{ m if m >= 10 else '0' ~ m }} PM{%- endif -%}
